claims.statement: Learn cost regression for selecting spatial k-nearest whole-route subproblems, solved by a black-box optimizer.
Regressor predicts new subsolution cost, not direct improvement; reject nonimproving repairs and cache unchanged candidates.
Default k10 LKH labels actually train on500/1000, not2000; Table6batch512 conflicts with prose2048, official README uses2048.
95% target means fraction of baseline improvement; uniform7x/12x/15x and HGS103x/198x should be separated from Random gains.
Belgium instances subsampled to2000/reset demands; uniform predictor sometimes worse than random.
HGS requires new labels and models, time-offset adjustment; strong500 final baseline and unconverged2000/3000 limit claims.
Variant/distribution/subsolver-specific trained selectors improve complete incumbents; specialist improvement, not shared generalist checkpoint.
